_comment: WP-K4c: the game effects the SCFxBuild commandlet rebuilds as Niagara systems under /Game/SC/FX (ue/Plugins/SCBridge/Source/SCBridgeFx). effects: particle effect references <GUID>|<library>.<effect> (GUIDs from Data/Libs/Particles/<library>.xml); Gadgets/tractor_beam.fps.muzzle_1st has every emitter disabled in LIVE 4.10.2, the multitool tractor record fires tractorbeam/fps_tractorbeam.FPS_Tractor_Beam.Muzzleflash_1st (a light). material_effects: MaterialEffects FXLib entries <lib>:<effect>; each builds the particle effects it plays. unlit_diffuse_scene_units: the viewer's stand-in for scene lighting on particles without EmissiveLighting (the masters are unlit): the luminance, in game scene units (FSCStarEngine::SceneUnitNits cd/m2 each), of a white DiffuseLighting=1 particle. A viewer approximation, not game data.
